Long Title: to provide for development of the area and management of Pilgrimage Tourism in and around the Maa Ambaji Temple at Ambaji in the State of Gujarat by providing necessary civic infrastructure through effective planning, administration, governance, and the matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
